member.summary: Main ViewModel for the UI application implementing the MVVM pattern. Manages server connectivity state, periodic data refresh, and exposes collections of active accounts, closed accounts, and recent client activity for data binding. Coordinates communication with the bank server via TCP services and reads persistent data through the database service.
